# Community Silver Benefits

## Deductible

The annual in-network deductible is $2,500 for an individual member. The deductible resets at the beginning of each plan year.

## Preventive care

Eligible in-network preventive services are covered before the deductible when billing and eligibility requirements are satisfied.

## Emergency care

Emergency services remain subject to the plan's applicable cost-sharing rules. Members should consult the current plan document for exclusions.
